head: Yebbi: free ink painting app for iPhone with brushes that react to touch
dek: Yebbi is a free ink painting studio for iPhone with four brushes, Round, Dry, Soft Wash and Ink Splash, that respond to how you press, move and lift your finger. It was #92 among free Graphics & Design apps on the US App Store on 24 November.
details: You pick Raw Xuan, Cotton or Hot Press paper, five ink tones and up to four pigment layers, and a side view shows the brush hairs bending on the paper. A reference photo and a voice note of up to two minutes can stay with each painting. Three illustrated Field Notes and a Brush Lab teach one stroke at a time. Paintings stay on your phone and export as PNG, PDF or an editable file; it's made by Marine Olivier, out since 4 November, and needs iOS 16 or later.
where: iPhone, iOS 16 or later, App Store, free
means: If you'd like to try ink painting without paper and brushes, Yebbi gives you a quiet practice space on your phone, with lessons and no account.
todo: Start with the Field Notes and the Brush Lab to learn how pressure changes a stroke, then save finished work to Photos.
